description: This file defines the interface CreateThingLiveCommand, which extends other interfaces related to live commands for creating and modifying 'Thing' objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides a method to retrieve the 'Thing' to be created.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommand
classes.description: Interface for a live command to create a 'Thing' with methods to access the Thing to be created and inherited command behaviors.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Returns the 'Thing' object that is to be created by this command.
